text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly adding to Stock C and later selling it near cost shows that a trade needs a clear reason to enter and a review point—not just a recent price move.","Selling several holdings at losses did not prevent later account declines; manage risk across the whole portfolio, not only by exiting individual losing positions.","After going several periods without trading, review whether the portfolio still fits the plan and compare its progress with the overall market rather than assuming that holding is working."]}
